proposed_statement_changes.reason: A standalone target-block certificate does not imply that the full shifts are generated by only \(r\) changed columns or that the baseline is a covariance.  For example, with \(d=2\), \(r=1\), and aggregate shift \(I_2\), a singleton principal block is positive although the aggregate rank is two.  Baseline positivity, exact aggregate rank, and every shift-range inclusion are therefore explicit necessary premises of the completion.

The converse recursion uses exact aggregate rank to make the residual vanish after \(r\) pivots, aggregate range inclusion to make every shift residual vanish with it, and baseline positivity to invoke the causal-fiber theorem.  These premises were dependencies but were absent from the displayed claim, so the claim is narrowed only by surfacing its actual hypotheses.

prose_updates.tldr: Under a designed minimum-variance baseline, stationary latent confounding and measurement error cancel from covariance differences.  No common all-target reference is needed: the aggregate carrier \(\bar Q=\sum_{e=1}^E\Delta_e\) has rank \(r\) and contains every shift range whenever shifts are nonnegative and every target changes in at least one environment.  A size-\(r\) label set is compatible exactly when some ordering passes the aggregate principal-block \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\) certificate, and every certificate has an acyclic Gaussian realization at any positive-definite baseline with strictly positive structural and measurement noises.  Subset-memoized pivots compute the complete family, while feasible-point augmentation gives always-nonempty honest family regions.  Information distance separates consistency from bounded-information impossibility, but local optimal certification is indexed by the full tangent-cone geometry rather than by distance alone.

project_justification.gap: Unknown-target methods with latent confounding return candidate supersets, whereas covariance-difference methods recover a global mixing matrix only under profile separation.  Existing heteroskedastic diagonalization and rotation-set results do not characterize every labeled acyclic target set at profile collisions or lift each certificate to a positive-noise SCM.
project_justification.niche: A minimum-variance baseline, nonnegative shifts, and panel-wide target coverage make the aggregate covariance difference a rank-\(r\) carrier.  Acyclicity then supplies a triangular labeling constraint that can be checked on candidate principal blocks even when no individual environment changes every target and individual changed columns are not globally identified.
project_justification.fill: The project gives an aggregate-carrier if-and-only-if labeled-fiber theorem, an arbitrary-baseline positive-noise converse, a signed-shift boundary witness, a complete subset recursion, always-nonempty honest family inference, a quantitative four-node collision, and a geometry-indexed characterization showing why no universal local envelope can depend only on scalar information distance.

sampling_model.design: Independent multi-sample Gaussian covariance experiment across environments \(e\in\mathcal E\) for inference; the population necessity argument itself uses only the declared second-moment invariance and independence conditions.
sampling_model.units: For each environment, \(n_e\) independent centered observations \(Y_{ei}\in\mathbb R^d\).
sampling_model.treatment: Unknown soft interventions change exactly \(r\) observed structural-noise variances.  The baseline is a minimum-variance condition, shifts are nonnegative, and each target changes in at least one nonbaseline environment; no common calibration environment is required.
sampling_model.overlap: Covariances obey \(mI_d\preceq\Sigma_e\preceq MI_d\); no separation from covariance-profile collisions is imposed.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The empirical covariance tuple is used directly.  Stationary latent confounding and stationary measurement error cancel from population covariance differences, and the aggregate of those differences carries the changing subspace.

prose_updates.related_work: Yang, Salehkaleybar, and Kiyavash motivate unknown-target matching under latent confounding but characterize a candidate superset rather than the complete labeled fiber.  BACKSHIFT motivates covariance differencing and global diagonalization, but it permits cyclic structural coefficients and does not assume a common all-target reference or a designated exact-rank carrier; the present acyclic aggregate-carrier theorem is therefore a different result.  coroICA likewise motivates differencing away group-wise stationary noise and uses variation conditions for unmixing recovery; aggregate exact rank and aggregate range inclusion here are derived consequences of nonnegative covered shifts in the legal causal model, or explicit premises for standalone observed-tuple reconstruction, rather than attributed coroICA hypotheses.  Yang et al. analyze measurement error after a recoverable mixing matrix is available, whereas invariant positive measurement error here cancels before the target fiber is characterized.  Bacchiocchi et al. study sign/permutation equivalence, distinct heteroskedastic eigenvalues, and restricted rotation sets at multiplicity, not the complete discrete family of observed acyclic target labels.  Jaber et al. and Squires et al. make completeness over unknown-target equivalence classes algorithmically central under graphical oracle conditions; the present recursion uses exact aggregate covariance pivots.  Brown--Purves selection and Romano--Shaikh identified-set inversion motivate the inference construction, while Lewis motivates robust inference near weak heteroskedastic separation.  Perturb-seq and Sci-Plex supply an application domain, but the output here concerns effective structural-noise targets only when the narrower covariance model is scientifically defensible.
prose_updates.interpretation: For a Perturb-seq or Sci-Plex panel, each nonbaseline condition may reveal only part of the effective perturbation support.  The aggregate certificate combines those conditions without assigning privileged status to one arm.  Report the full compatible family, its compulsory intersection, and its possible union; interpret a singleton only when the augmented classification image is a singleton.  These labels describe effective variance-shift coordinates in the acyclic covariance model, not direct molecular binding sites, and uncertain or environment-dependent perturbation efficacy should be carried as abstention or a larger family rather than collapsed to a single target.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The model assumes environment-invariant structural coefficients, latent covariance, and measurement-error covariance, fixed dimension, a minimum-variance baseline, nonnegative structural-variance increments, and panel-wide coverage of every declared target.  For arbitrary observed tuples, positive-noise completion and recursive completeness explicitly require positive baseline covariance, exact rank of \(\bar Q\), and inclusion of every shift range in \(\operatorname{range}(\bar Q)\); these follow for tuples generated by the legal causal model but not from a target-block certificate alone.  Signed shifts remain outside the certificate because primitive variance feasibility then depends on unknown baseline structural variances.  The semialgebraic algorithm is a certification route rather than a transcriptome-scale complexity claim, and the exact local power value requires the complete incident tangent geometry.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The aggregate sharp fiber, positive-noise realization, subset recursion, measurable approximate selector, finite-sample family coverage, two-regime information boundary, and four-node collision rate are theorem-level claims.  The finite-sample sufficient threshold remains \(\sqrt{2}m\delta_n(\theta)>2c_{\alpha}+1\) on the stated confidence event, with the full \(x\)-indexed bound retained for consistency.  A universal one-variable local envelope is not claimed: the proved negative result gives an explicit geometry-indexed Gaussian optimization and same-distance witness showing that \(c\) alone is insufficient.  When \(r=1\), the aggregate result reduces to the ambiguity \(\{\{j\}:\bar Q_{jj}>0\}\); no stronger single-target identification is asserted.
